statement: For B_3=(2^{[3]}, subseteq), under the local-realizer and relative-dimension definitions frozen in problem.md, every local realizer has total element-occurrence cost at least 16, while the three displayed PLEs have total cost 16. Therefore the minimum cost is exactly 16 and rdim(B_3)=2.
contribution: This resolves the frozen original claim. Relative to the inspected arXiv:2609.05166v1 text, which supplies the cost-16 upper witness, the new component is an explicit symmetric rational covering dual of value 16. Its feasibility has a short universal proof and is also replayed in exact arithmetic over all 1,323 PLEs, generated by two exhaustive enumeration methods.
